ABOUT.HEADING: About me
ABOUT.INTRO: Hey, I'm Cristian. I build web applications end to end, from the interface people click on down to the data that feeds it. What keeps me coming back to code is the moment an idea finally behaves the way I pictured it, and the next idea that opens up.
ABOUT.LOCATION: Based in Berlin, open to remote work across Europe and happy to relocate for the right team.
ABOUT.CURIOSITY: Curious by default. Angular and TypeScript are where I feel at home, and React and Vue are next on my list. Picking up a new stack is part of the job, not an obstacle.
ABOUT.PROBLEM_SOLVING: I break a problem down until every piece is small enough to reason about, then look for the simplest solution that still holds up. Analytical thinking, persistence and asking the right questions early keep the surprises small.

SKILLS.HEADING: Skill Set
SKILLS.INTRO: I work across the whole front end: semantic HTML, modern CSS, TypeScript and Angular, wired up to REST APIs and real-time data. I care about accessible markup, clear component boundaries and code the next developer can read. Web development moves fast, so learning is part of my routine rather than something I fit in afterwards.
SKILLS.QUESTION: You need
SKILLS.INVITE: Get in touch. I enjoy working past what I already know, and I pick up new tools quickly.

PROJECTS.HEADING: Featured Projects
PROJECTS.INTRO: A selection of the things I have built. Open any project to see what it does, which stack it runs on and where the code lives.

ITEMS.JOIN: Task manager built on the Kanban principle. Create tasks, move them between columns by drag and drop and assign them to categories and team members.
ITEMS.EL_POLLO_LOCO: Jump and run game built on an object oriented architecture. Help Pepe collect coins and tabasco bottles to take on the crazy hen.
ITEMS.POKEDEX: Pokédex built on the PokéAPI. Browse Pokémon as cards that load in batches, search them by name and open any one to see its stats and flip through the rest.

CONTACT.TEXT: I am looking for a team where I can own real features and keep learning from people who are further along than me. Tell me what you are building and what is in the way, and I will tell you honestly how I can help.
